description: This file defines the 'File' class within the namespace Opencart.System.Library.Cache, implementing a caching mechanism using the file system. It includes methods to get, set, and delete cache files, as well as a destructor to clean up expired cache files.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class that provides file-based caching functionality, handling cache retrieval, storage, deletion, and cleanup of expired cache files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with an optional expiration time (default 3600 seconds).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a given key by reading cache files matching the key pattern.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data in the cache associated with a key, with an optional specific expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache files associated with a given key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired cache files when the object is destroyed, with a probabilistic trigger.
